title: Elementary Quantum Gates from Lie Group Embeddings in $U(2^n)$: Geometry, Universality, and Discretization
summary: In the standard circuit model, elementary gates are defined relative to a chosen tensor factorization and are therefore extrinsic to the ambient group $U(2^n)$. Writing $N=2^n$, we introduce an \emph{intrinsic descriptor layer} in $U(N)$ by declaring as primitive the motions inside faithful embedded copies of $SU(2)$ (phase-free), together with a phase-inclusive $U(2)$ variant.
